verdicts.reason: A uses a sensible two-column banner layout with the headline dominant and the CTA bottom-right. Its flaws: the product can is shrunk to a tiny afterthought, the SUNSET SALE badge floats between the logo and the can, the legal text block is wedged into the left column, and the right column is cramped against the edges. B has worse problems. The SUNSET SALE badge collides with the headline's first line. The legal fine print sits right under the headline, above the body copy, so it ranks too high and breaks the reading order. The product can is gone entirely. A broken placeholder image overlaps the bottom-right corner. The badges and the CTA are jumbled together in a cramped bottom cluster.
